title: Lunar South Pole Explorer
referenceFrame: LOLA: MOON_ME / JPL DE421. LROC stereo: native producer coordinates tied to historical LOLA; specific ephemeris frame not declared in product label.
coordinateConvention: Pixel-centre coordinates in metres. X east, Y toward longitude 0. Rows proceed from yMax southward (decreasing projected Y).
encoding: little-endian int16, gzip compressed; elevation metres = sample * scale + offset; nodata -32768
heightDatum: Elevation in metres relative to the 1,737,400 m lunar reference sphere.

datasets.name: Shackleton rim · LROC stereo
notes: Native 2 m DLR stereo-photogrammetric DTM. Only confidence class 14 (successful image matching) retained; source shadowed/interpolated/undefined classes fall back to LOLA. Valid source heights unchanged.
Same lunar south-polar stereographic projection and 1737400 m reference sphere.
Producer reports 0.5 m RMS alignment to selected historical LOLA tracks; not a per-pixel accuracy guarantee.
Orthomosaic horizontal offsets relative to DTM vary by several metres or more per source README.

Rendered geometry blends to the underlying LOLA surface over 20 m at source nodata boundaries. Weights start at 0 at the first valid 2 m grid cell and reach 1 at 22 m from nodata. Source DTM heights are unchanged; the blend is an explicit visualization seam treatment.
datasets.blendMaskEncoding: Gzip row-major Uint8, same width/height/georeferencing as the DEM. Weight=sample/255; 0 uses underlying LOLA, 1 uses stereo DTM.
datasets.referenceFrame: Native LROC/DLR south-polar stereographic tied to historical LOLA tracks; product label does not specify DE421.

notes: LOLA laser-altimetry-derived, surface-interpolated DEMs, not photographic textures.
Grid spacing is not guaranteed feature resolution: NASA reports that approximately 90 percent of the original 5 m site pixels are interpolated between laser returns.
The original site RoIs have median RMS height uncertainty around 0.30–0.50 m; this statistic is not a pointwise error guarantee across every displayed pixel.
Coarser overview layers are resampled for browser performance. Source native spacing is stored per layer.
Artificial illumination in the renderer is illustrative, not an ephemeris-driven prediction or permanent-shadow classification.
LOLA heights use0.5m quantization (maximum0.25m additional rounding); local stereo heights use0.1m (maximum0.05m).
The new stereo DTM keeps only producer confidenceclass14; holes use LOLA. A20m transition blends into LOLA at the confidence-mask boundary.
The local1m orthomosaic has captured illumination; it is not an albedo map. Producer cautions that local image-to-DTM alignment varies by several metres.
